name: client-bound-ecdh-p256
description: A versioned client-bound ECDH-P256 delivery profile vector. The issuer uses the injected P-256 ephemeral pair and nonce below to wrap one 16-byte delivered key for the client public JWK. The wire contract is expected.transport (the client-bound mode, method and semantic ephemeral public JWK) plus expected.wrappedKey ({key, nonce}); the client combines that public key with its private fixture key, runs HKDF-SHA256 with empty salt and UTF-8 info DCA-client-bound-transport, and opens the AES-256-GCM value without additional data. Both seal and open are deterministic here because the ephemeral keypair and nonce are inputs rather than fresh draws. The opened key is an AES-GCM handle in WebCrypto; openedKeyBase64url states the raw value another runtime must recover.
